componentSurfaces.name: central-balcony-front-rail-top
componentSurfaces.basis: The 2025 full crop and wider same-panorama context directly show the central balcony's frontal rail from approximately x40 to x126, with top and bottom rails and repeated vertical ironwork. Independent 2022 panorama 5e961d5ea35ca091bd71860ee695c04bda32170d2e3b41592811c96148174ba4 confirms the projecting central balcony front, supports and three-bay arrangement, but supplies no measured depth. The photographed geometry to the right in the 2025 crop is an oblique side return and underside, so it is excluded from this rectangular frontal assembly; brackets and fine ornament remain omitted.
